capabilities: Detect images not referenced in any note, canvas, frontmatter, HTML tag, or admonition block
Review orphaned images in a sidebar panel with thumbnails, paths, sizes, and checkboxes
Generate a report note of orphaned images grouped by folder with file sizes
Delete selected or all orphaned images with confirmation, trash support, and a safety scan
Scope scanning to included or excluded folders
extras: The README documents detection limitations (bare frontmatter values, some Excalidraw usage, external URLs) and ships a safety scan enabled by default to avoid deleting images the detector cannot see; deletion moves files to trash by default.
motivation: The author says the plugin was inspired by the need to keep vaults organized and efficient.
problem: Obsidian keeps embedded media as regular vault files but offers no built-in way to find which images are no longer referenced by any note.

relations.evidence: embeds inside legacy Admonitions code blocks (```ad-note)

summary: Vault cleaner that finds images not linked by any note, with a review panel, a report note, and selective or bulk deletion.
